t: 马塔拉姆的阿芒库拉特二世和他的保镖处决了叛军领袖特鲁纳贾亚.
te: Amangkurat II of Mataram and his bodyguards execute the rebel leader Trunajaya.
dz: 特鲁纳贾亚叛乱:马塔拉姆的阿芒库拉特二世和他的保镖处决了叛军领袖特鲁纳贾亚.
de: Trunajaya rebellion: Amangkurat II of Mataram and his bodyguards execute the rebel leader Trunajaya.

t: 普韦布洛起义在新墨西哥地区爆发。
te: The Pueblo Revolt begins in New Mexico.
dz: 普韦布洛起义在新墨西哥地区爆发。
de: The Pueblo Revolt begins in New Mexico.

t: Pueblo印第安人在"Pueblo Revolt"期间从西班牙人手中夺取了圣菲.
te: Pueblo Indians capture Santa Fe from the Spanish during the Pueblo Revolt.
dz: Pueblo印第安人在"Pueblo Revolt"期间从西班牙人手中夺取了圣菲.
de: Pueblo Indians capture Santa Fe from the Spanish during the Pueblo Revolt.

t: 德国天文学家 Gottfried Kirch 发现了 1680 年大彗星，这是第一颗通过望远镜…
te: German astronomer Gottfried Kirch discovers the Great Comet of 1680, the first comet to be discovered by telescope.
dz: 德国天文学家 Gottfried Kirch 发现了 1680 年大彗星，这是第一颗通过望远镜发现的彗星。
de: German astronomer Gottfried Kirch discovers the Great Comet of 1680, the first comet to be discovered by telescope.
